statements.text: Assessment: left cervical radiculopathy at C5-C6 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
MRI cervical spine 08/16/2026: C5-C6 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Baseline ODI prior to any intervention: 47%.
Reports neck pain radiating to the left arm for 24 weeks.
Completed physical therapy from 04/22/2026 to 05/20/2026 (4 weeks) with no lasting benefit, and failed ibuprofen 600 mg TID.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
Epidural steroid injection history: 1 cervical injection in the past 12 months (07/18/2026).
